content:
Elena M.: Quick sync on SLATE ahead of their QBR — saw a token burn spike last week. Need: updated spend forecast, brief enablement recipe for their engineers, and anything that looks like a renewal risk. Can folks volunteer?
ops-bot: billing-alert: account=slate | usage_threshold=85% | current_run_rate=0.92x | alert_ts=1765123460
Ravi P.: I dug in — spike correlates with nightly embedding batch (indexing of new docs). Rough extra tokens ~260k over 48h. Might be misconfigured sharding + high batch_size.
Ravi P.: Quick check query I ran:
```sql
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account='slate' AND date >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
```
FinanceBot: Quick forecast (naive run-rate + current anomaly):
- Baseline monthly: $12,400
- Current projected (with spike): $18,100
- Worst-case (sustained): $24,300
Recommend adding a $10k buffer for this quarter in the QBR slides.
Maya L.: Scheduling: QBR set for Tue 9am PT. We need 3 slides from CS: 1) cost breakdown + anomaly explanation, 2) suggested mitigations + ops playbook, 3) renewal risk + recommended contract language. @Ben S. can you help with the mitigations slide? @Ravi P. please confirm numbers.
Ben S.: Yep. Two quick levers that are low friction: 1) reduce embedding batch_size from 2048 -> 512 (quick win), 2) route low-priority requests to the 8-bit quantized variant during overnight indexing. Estimated savings: ~40% on embedding cost for the batch window.
Ben S.: Example config snippet to throttle batch jobs in their scheduler:
```yaml
jobs:
  nightly-index:
    schedule: "0 2 * * *"
    concurrency: 1
    env:
      EMBED_BATCH_SIZE: 512
      MODEL_VARIANT: embed-quant-8b
```
Elena M.: Perfect. Action items: @Ravi P. update the spend forecast and add the 48h token histogram to slide 1 (due EOD today). @Ben S. create mitigation slide + one-paragraph ops playbook (due tomorrow). @Maya L. draft the renewal ask + buffer recommendation and I'll review. :+1:
Maya L.: I'll also pull feedback from their engineering lead about why they increased batch_size — want to capture root cause in the QBR so it doesn't read like a scapegoat.
Ravi P.: Will update. One note: their app has a retry loop that duplicated requests when a timeout occurred — that likely doubled some runs. I can add a suggested fix and sample retry-backoff config.
ops-bot: alert-acknowledged by @Ravi P. | escalation: none | next_check=1765127050
FinanceBot: Also recommend enabling the budget-alert webhook with threshold at 110% of baseline to avoid surprises. Quick setup:
```json
{ "account":"slate", "threshold_pct":110, "notify_channels":["#cs-alerts","slate-billing@redwood.com"] }
```
Ben S.: I can join the QBR to walk through the mitigation steps if useful. I can also prepare a short demo of switching to the quantized variant (5-10min).
Elena M.: Yes please. @Ben S. join Tue 9am PT. Last ask: let's capture one line of customer feedback about cost sensitivity and any internal budget cycles so Sales has a talking point.
Maya L.: I'll add that to the slides — asked them to send fiscal cadence in the pre-QBR survey.
Elena M.: Great. Closing the loop — I'll post the slide links here when ready. Thanks team. :rocket:
